# NSR-1 brain carrier — Raspberry Pi Zero 2W

Source of truth: [`netlist-spec.md`](netlist-spec.md). This is the first
SBC-specific carrier; Radxa/Orange Pi carriers are separate boards.

## Generated files

- `brain.kicad_sch` — generated by `python3 hardware/tools/gen_schematics.py`.
  Do not hand-edit while the generator is active.
- `brain.kicad_pcb` — outline and mounting holes generated by
  `hardware/tools/make_platform_outlines.py`; the routed layout becomes
  hand-owned after the first placement.

## Checks

```bash
python3 hardware/tools/gen_schematics.py
python3 hardware/tools/export_netlist.py --board brain
cd hardware/brain
kicad-cli sch erc brain.kicad_sch --output /tmp/brain-erc.json --format json --severity-all
kicad-cli pcb drc brain.kicad_pcb --output /tmp/brain-drc.json --format json --severity-all
emd import kicad brain.net.xml --out /tmp/brain.json
emd validate /tmp/brain.json
```

Current status: schematic generated, 0 ERC errors, expected
`lib_symbol_mismatch` warnings only; netlist validates in EMD; PCB outline
110 × 90 mm with 4× M3 holes; placement not started.
